 Advertising 49ers Activate LB Jalen Graham and WR Malik Turner From Practice Squad; Other Moves
 Oct 19, 2026 at 01:08 PM 
 Copied! 
 The San Francisco 49ers  announced the following roster moves:
 The following players have been activated from the team's practice squad (standard elevations):
 Pos.                Number         Name 
 LB                   41                    Jalen Graham
 WR                 86                    Malik Turner
 In addition, WR Christian Kirk's game status has been downgraded from questionable to out.
 Related Content 
 news 49ers Promote DL Ogbo Okoronkwo, Sign LB Eugene Asante, and Make Other Moves
 The 49ers announced they have promoted DL Ogbo Okoronkwo to the active roster and signed LB Eugene Asante to the team's practice squad. In addition, the team opened the practice window for WR Christian Kirk (Injured Reserve List).
 news 49ers Announce Roster Moves Ahead of #SFvsSEA
 The 49ers have activated DL Mykel Williams, sign DL Ogbo Okoronkwo to the practice squad.
 news 49ers Release DL Ogbo Okoronkwo
 The 49ers announced they released DL Ogbo Okoronkwo.
 news 49ers Make Practice Squad Moves
 The 49ers announced they have signed WR Xavier Smith to the team's practice squad and placed WR Dante Pettis on the Practice Squad Injured Reserve List.
 news 49ers Sign DL Fehoko Jr. to Practice Squad
 The 49ers announced they have signed DL Viliami Fehoko Jr. to the team's practice squad.
 news 49ers Announce Roster Moves Ahead of #DENvsSF
 The 49ers promoted DL Sebastian Valdez to the active roster, activated two players from the practice squad, and waived DL Viliami Fehoko Jr.
 news 49ers Promote WR Cooks to Active Roster, Sign WR Turner to Practice Squad; More Moves
 The 49ers have promoted WR Brandin Cooks to the active roster, and signed WR Malik Turner to team's practice squad. In order to make room on the roster, the team released WR KhaDarel Hodge.
 news 49ers Sign WR Dante Pettis to Practice Squad
 The 49ers have signed WR Dante Pettis to the team's practice squad.
 news 49ers Sign DL Judon to the Practice Squad
 The 49ers have signed DL Matthew Judon to the team's practice squad.
 news 49ers Make a Series of Roster Moves Ahead of #AZvsSF
 The 49ers promoted DL Viliami Fehoko Jr. to the active roster, activated two players from the practice squad and placed a wide receiver on the injured reserve list.
 news 49ers Sign DL Naquan Jones, Add WR Brandin Cooks to the Practice Squad; More Roster Moves
 The 49ers have signed DL Naquan Jones to a one-year deal and signed WR Brandin Cooks and DL Viliami Fehoko Jr. to the practice squad. In order to make room on the roster, the team released CB Jakob Robinson and placed DL C.J. West on the Injured Reserve List.
